final_message:
I wrote the discrepancy memo comparing the May 12, 2025 matter plan against the executed May 5, 2025 engagement letter. It passes the docx validator and reads back cleanly. The memo covers 22 issues, each with section cites, a severity rating and a recommended fix. The biggest ones are a wrong fee cap ($1.95M vs. $1.85M), a wrong discount (15% vs. 12%, so every rate is off), and a missing workstream: IP and patent portfolio review. Other major issues are a retainer applied to interim invoices instead of held for the final one, and a post-closing support period of 90 days instead of 60. The plan's $148M enterprise value also conflicts with its own figures.
